# Key
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Tap \[F\] at the driver's side of the vehicle it was cut for, or the bike its padlock locks, to lock or unlock it. With a Motor it makes a Locksmith Kit at a Workbench.*

## Crafting

- By hand: [Locksmith Kit](Locksmith-Kit) (kept) + [Padlock](Padlock) (kept)
- On the ground with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept), 18.5 s: [Key](Key) + [Motor](Motor) + [Key](Key) (kept)
